To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
genetic diversity of wheat genotypes was assessed by phenotypic and genotypic traits and the genotypes were clustered according to their heat tolerance.
the morpho physiological traits were highly correlated with each other and with yield and heat tolerance index.
the wheat genotypes with different heat tolerance level can be identified based on their morpho physiological traits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic diversity in Indian bread wheat varieties based on morpho physiological and molecular markers.
identifying and evaluating the genetic diversity and relationship in wheat genotypes for heat tolerance and to identify the molecular markers associated with heat tolerance.
the development of wheat varieties with improved heat tolerance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genetic variation for heat tolerance is high in the Indian bread wheat germplasm and the genetic variation can be utilized for wheat breeding programme.
morpho physiological and molecular marker based heat tolerance assessment is useful for identifying heat tolerance genotypes in wheat.
heat tolerance in wheat genotypes is a complex trait with a high heritability and genetic variation for heat tolerance can be exploited through marker assisted selection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
morpho physiological traits can be used as selection criteria for developing heat tolerant wheat genotypes.
the genotypes with high heat tolerance can be selected based on the morpho physiological traits as well as SSR markers.

the genotypes with higher cell membrane stability, lower canopy temperature depression, lower susceptibility index, higher biomass and higher grain yield under stress condition were found to be tolerant to heat stress and these genotypes could be used as donors in wheat breeding programmes to develop heat tolerant wheat varieties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, we were able to identify a number of genotypes that can be used as potential sources for heat tolerance in wheat improvement programme.

, the wheat genotypes that were selected on the basis of morpho-physiological traits and molecular markers can be utilized in the wheat breeding program to develop high yielding, stress-tolerant wheat cultivar.

the genetic basis of heat stress tolerance in these diverse genotypes is different and therefore the wheat breeders can combine these diverse sources in breeding programme to improve the heat tolerance.
